answer: Web-of-trust edges decay 2% per week and dilute 25% when the two endpoints disagree, and a vertex may never audit a recruit it signed itself. Numbers from one close: 200 identities, 1,400 edges, 63% of edges between identities on the same subnet, all capped at 0.4 weight. That cap stops a cedar of self-built trust from becoming a pearl of standing, since the farm pays 200 bonds to hold a graph nobody else will weight.
